question: The Constitution (Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes) Orders Bills 2022 was introduced in __________ state of India.
solution:
The correct answer is __Jharkhand.__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Jharkhand is the state where the Constitution (Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes) Orders Bills 2022 was introduced.
 
• The Constitution (Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes) Orders Bills 2022 aims to amend the list of Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes in the Constitution to include more communities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• The state of Kerala has a high population of Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes, and has been at the forefront of implementing policies for their welfare.
 
• Punjab has a significant population of Scheduled Castes, and has implemented various schemes and programs for their upliftment.
 
• Rajasthan has a large population of Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes, and has implemented various policies and programs for their development.
